camel_example: aliyun ndr UpdatePrivateTractionAttributes --region cn-hangzhou --MaxTraffic '-1' --AutoAccess true --VpcInstanceId 'vpc-bp1example' --TimeConfig '00:00_23:59_0_0' --version 2024-01-24 --method POST --force
description_en: Modifies the traffic limit and execution time configuration of a specified VPC
description_zh: 修改指定 VPC 的流量上限和执行时间配置
name: UpdatePrivateTractionAttributes

parameters.help_en: The upper limit of private network traffic mirroring, in GB. A value of -1 indicates no limit
parameters.help_zh: 私网引流流量上限，单位为 GB。-1 表示不限制
parameters.name: max_traffic

parameters.help_en: The traffic mirroring time configuration. You can specify a fixed start time and end time, or configure a recurring schedule by start time, end time, day of the week, and date. For example, 00:00 23:59 * * indicates all-day execution every day. You cannot specify both the day of the week and the date at the same time
parameters.help_zh: 引流时间配置。支持固定起止时间，或按开始时间、结束时间、星期和日期设置周期，例如 00:00 23:59 * * 表示每天全天执行。星期与日期不能同时限定
parameters.name: time_config

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to automatically include new ENIs subsequently added to this VPC
parameters.help_zh: 是否自动接入该VPC后续新增的网卡
parameters.name: auto_access

AutoAccess.description_en: The updated automatic accessed state after the modification
AutoAccess.description_zh: 修改后的自动接入状态
AutoAccess.title_en: 修改后的自动接入状态
AutoAccess.title_zh: 修改后的自动接入状态
